annotations.text:
SPINR RIDER v4 — iOS App Store, iPhone 6.7" · 1290 × 2796

Faithful to the shipped app: iPhone frame with Dynamic Island, default
Google-Maps-style map, RouteLine's real #FF9500→#EE2B2B gradient
polyline, RoutePins spec (green dot pickup), the real car_marker@3x.png
sprites, and vehicle tiers straight from production Supabase
(Economy / Van / XL — names, capacities, descriptions).

Payment/receipt frame removed on request. The mocked SOS screen is
replaced by two text-content screens that mirror OLA/Bolt-style sets:
the Spinr Assistant welcome (real greeting, real quick prompts) and
Help & Support (real tabs + production FAQ questions).

VEHICLE ART — the hosted Supabase illustrations (vehicle-illustrations
bucket) are unreachable from this build environment, so the rows use
drawn side-view stand-ins in the app's own car-art palette. Drop the
real files in as veh-sedan.webp / veh-van.webp / veh-xl.webp next to
_screens.py and re-run the build — they are picked up automatically.

SAMPLE DATA — swap before submitting: fares, Saskatoon addresses,
"Sam R.", plate 4WX 812, ratings, driver counts, ETAs. Tier names,
capacities and FAQ questions are real production values.
